_comment: Enforced ratchet for the session-start context cost. `limits` may only ever DECREASE -- bin/context-budget.py --set-baseline refuses to raise one, and every enforced metric is PER ENTRY or an invariant (means are reported, never enforced: a mean is a total wearing a per-entry label, and reddens on honest growth), so writing a genuinely new memory is free while writing a bloated one is not. `targets` are what CLAUDE.md's and MEMORY.md's own one-line invariants ask for; they are reported as debt, never enforced, so the gap stays visible. Keys in `targets` but not `limits` are the BILL (total bytes, hook text abbreviated away): reported every run, never used to fail one.
